description: Buy a domain through Hermoso, priced in dollars. The registrant (firstName, lastName, email, phone +1.4155550100, address1, city, state, zip, country) owns it; WHOIS privacy is free; auto-renew is on. Without confirm:true nothing happens and you get the exact fees and the domain registration agreement to show the user; once they accept it, confirm:true with acceptRegistrationAgreement:true returns a Stripe payment link for the USER to open and pay by card (nothing is charged in the chat), and the domain registers within about a minute of paying. Needs a paid plan or bought credits. page optionally names the hosted project it is for.

acceptRegistrationAgreement.description: true only after the user accepted the domain registration agreement

confirm.description: true only after the user approved it

page.description: the hosted project this domain is for

registrant.description: who will own the domain (ICANN needs real details)
